3.name: Bonus Proficiencies & Cutting Words
3.description: Gain proficiency in any 3 skills; spend Bardic Inspiration as a Reaction to subtract your Inspiration die from an enemy's attack, ability check, or damage roll.

6.name: Additional Magical Secrets
6.description: Learn two spells of your choice from any class list (included in your Bard Spells Known).

14.name: Peerless Skill
14.description: Add a Bardic Inspiration die to your own ability check.

3.name: Combat Inspiration & Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: Gain Medium Armor, Shields, and Martial Weapons proficiency; allies can add Bardic Inspiration to weapon damage or AC as a Reaction.

6.name: Extra Attack (College of Valor)
6.description: Attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

14.name: Battle Magic
14.description: When you use your Action to cast a Bard spell, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

3.name: Mantle of Inspiration & Enthralling Performance
3.description: Expend Bardic Inspiration as a Bonus Action to grant allies Temporary HP and reaction movement; charm listeners after 1 minute of performance.

6.name: Mantle of Majesty
6.description: Bonus Action for 1 min: cast Command each turn as a Bonus Action without expending a slot (1/Long Rest).

14.name: Unbreakable Majesty
14.description: Bonus Action causes attackers within view to make a CHA save or be unable to target you with attacks for the turn (1/Short Rest).

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies, Fighting Style & Blade Flourish
3.description: Gain Medium Armor & Scimitar proficiency, choose Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting, and expend Bardic Inspiration on Defensive, Slashing, or Mobile Flourishes.

6.name: Extra Attack (College of Swords)
6.description: Attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

14.name: Master's Flourish
14.description: Whenever you use a Blade Flourish, you can roll a d6 instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.

3.name: Psychic Blades & Words of Terror
3.description: Expend Bardic Inspiration on weapon hit for +2d6 Psychic damage (scales at L5/10/15); frighten a target after 1 minute of private conversation.

6.name: Mantle of Whispers
6.description: Reaction when a humanoid dies within 30 ft to capture its shadow and magically disguise yourself as them (1/Short Rest).

14.name: Shadow Lore
14.description: Whisper magical threats to magically charm a creature into obeying your commands for 8 hours (1/Long Rest).

psychic_blades.name: Psychic Blades
psychic_blades.hint: Expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to deal extra psychic damage.

3.name: Silver Tongue & Unsettling Words
3.description: Treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10 on Persuasion and Deception checks; Bonus Action subtracts Bardic Inspiration from a target's next saving throw.

6.name: Unfailing Inspiration & Universal Speech
6.description: Allies keep their Bardic Inspiration die if their roll still fails; speak so any creature understands you for 1 hour (1/Long Rest or slot).

14.name: Infectious Inspiration
14.description: When an ally succeeds using your Bardic Inspiration, Reaction grants another ally Inspiration free (CHA mod/Long Rest).

3.name: Mote of Potential & Performance of Creation
3.description: Your Bardic Inspiration adds secondary attack/check/save bonuses; conjure nonmagical objects worth up to 20 x Bard level gp (1/Long Rest or slot).

6.name: Animating Performance
6.description: Animate a Large or smaller nonmagical item as a Dancing Item under your command (1/Long Rest or 3rd+ spell slot).

14.name: Creative Crescendo
14.description: Create multiple objects simultaneously with Performance of Creation with no gp value limit.

3.name: Guiding Whispers & Tales from Beyond
3.description: Learn Guidance with 60 ft range; use a Spiritual Focus and expend Bardic Inspiration to roll random Spirits' Tales effects.

6.name: Spiritual Focus Empowerment & Spirit Session
6.description: Add +1d6 healing or damage to Bard spells via Spiritual Focus; conduct a ritual to temporarily know a Divination/Necromancy spell from any class.

14.name: Mystical Connection
14.description: Roll twice on the Spirits' Tales table and choose which tale takes effect.
